desc: Prove that the minimum number of operations equals the number of consecutive-value components among the distinct values in a subarray.
Derive the fixed-right-endpoint formula \(f(L,R)=\sum_x [x\text{ present},\,x-1\text{ absent}]\), giving \(C_R=\sum_x\max(\text{last}[x]-\text{last}[x-1],0)\).
Determine that changing the latest occurrence of \(v\) affects only the terms for \(v\) and \(v+1\).
Implement and verify the \(O(N)\) sweep, including repeated and consecutive values and all public samples.
